result.title: Are Multimodal Benchmarks Really Useful? Item-Level Multimodal Benchmark Diagnosis via Structure-Response Co-Calibration
result.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 34 pages, including appendices
result.summary: Multimodal benchmarks are central to evaluating whether models can reason over information from multiple modalities. However, existing literature has revealed that some benchmarks may contain shortcut items that can be answered from a single modality or from answer-option regularities alone, thus failing to reflect models' true cross-modal inference ability. Existing methods for assessing benchmarks typically rely either on intrinsic item structure or extrinsic model response behavior, which are not adequate for a comprehensive diagnosis. To fill in this gap, we propose SRCoD, a structure-response co-calibrated diagnosis framework for item-level diagnosis of modality dependence in multimodal benchmarks. SRCoD estimates sample-wise multimodal information structure from benchmark content and target answers, and uses this signal as a soft structural anchor for modality-conditioned item response modeling. The learned model produces a calibrated item-level diagnostic profile that reflects how strongly an item depends on different forms of modality evidence, enabling fine-grained benchmark analysis beyond aggregate accuracy. SRCoD also provides interpretable attribution of the diagnosis results. Extensive experiments under two complementary protocols, i.e., benchmark-refinement oriented validation and human-labeled item validation, demonstrate that SRCoD outperforms state-of-the-art benchmark diagnosis methods.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SRCoD 框架，从基准内容与目标答案估计样本级多模态信息结构，并以此作为软结构锚点进行模态条件项目反应建模，输出 item 级诊断画像，判断每道题对多模态证据的依赖程度，以识别只靠单一模态或选项规律即可作答的捷径题。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于 VLM 多模态推理的基准诊断与失败分析，与「视觉证据是否被真正使用」直接相关；其 item 级模态依赖信号可供核查是否用于评估 LOOK 的必要性、视觉旁路与证据筛选。
